Gap G2 has nothing in the specs or the code yet. No spec names a usage-limit pause, and the gate code doesn't read `usage_limit`. The findings below are the single line the step asks for.

ARTIFACT gap_finding: Nothing exists for G2. I searched `plugins/` for "usage_limit", "usage limit" and "resets_at". `gate-and-human.spec.md` has no usage-limit text, and HUM-B7 to HUM-B11 (lines 21-51) name no such pause. HUM-B7 (line 21) lists the escalation triggers and HUM-B8 (line 28) the budget pauses. HUM-B9 (line 35) covers approval and HUM-B10 (line 41) event_wait/input/breakpoint. HUM-B11 (line 47) says an infra failure never pauses. HUM-B2 (line 15) lists the payload fields: kind, unit, item, reason, artifacts, rubric, decisions, resume_command. It names no reset time. HUM-AC2 (line 102) names B2, B7-B10, not B11. The input is already specified: `session-contract.spec.md` SSN-B11 (line 88) and SSN-AC8 (line 103), and `executor-claude-code.spec.md` line 93 (the reset read from `resetsAt` as epoch seconds, null for `credits_required`) and ECC-AC11 (line 199). `contracts.py:717-718` has `usage_limit` and `usage_limit_resets_at: float | None`. Related decisions: ADR `a-review-that-hit-a-usage-limit-is-run-again-once.adr.md` (line 47: gates, ladders and ledgers don't read `usage_limit`), and research `what-a-claude-session-reports-when-its-usage-allowance-is-spent.rsrch.md`. In `run/gate.py`, `pause_payload` (255-284) takes kind and reason as strings, and the payload dict (268-270) has no reset field. Extras are added per kind, for example `questions` for input (275-281) and `event` for event_wait (282-284). `to_human(kind, reason)` is called at lines 373 (budget), 379 (input), 381 (event_wait) and 393 (escalation, cause in `ESCALATE_CAUSES`). The gate's reads of the attempt (`att.get`, 375-393) include no usage-limit flag. The `to_human` and `ESCALATE_CAUSES` definitions weren't read. `run/events.py:154` handles kind "budget" (not read further). SIL-B25/B26 and SRV-B30 are out of scope. The spec needs a new behaviour in `gate-and-human` (or a reason under an existing kind), a payload field `usage_limit_resets_at`, and HUM-B11 and HUM-AC2 touched.
